name: io.github.davidb3l/catryna
title: Catryna Wikinelli
description: Living documentation of the Sothis suite. Claude Code stdio MCP; Windows, macOS, Linux.

com.catrynawiki.suite: Sothis suite — Sirius Forester (foreman), Hayvenhurst (code graph), Ametrite (board), Catryna Wikinelli (docs), PingMyBell (the bell)
com.catrynawiki.role: living documentation — git-versioned MDX docs in .docs/, readable by agents and humans
com.catrynawiki.mcpCommand: bash ${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/scripts/run-server.sh (plugin) or `bun run src/index.ts` from a checkout
clients: any MCP client that speaks stdio JSON-RPC
com.catrynawiki.install: Claude Code plugin: `claude plugin marketplace add Davidb3l/Sirius-Forester` then `claude plugin install catryna@sirius-forester`. Requires bun (https://bun.sh).
com.catrynawiki.projectScopeConfig: A repo-root .mcp.json with { "mcpServers": { "catryna": { "command": "bun", "args": ["run", "src/index.ts"] } } } works inside a Catryna checkout; elsewhere point the command at the installed plugin root.
com.catrynawiki.requires: the server keeps the client's cwd — it resolves .docs/ from process.cwd()
